sources.entry: Cate - Open-source IDE on an infinite zoomable canvas, with editor, terminal, browser, and AI agent panels arranged in a spatial workspace. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/0-AI-UG/cate) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: CATE
summary.one_liner: CATE (Canvas Terminal Editor) is an open-source IDE on an infinite zoomable canvas where terminals, editors, browsers, and AI agent panels float in one spatial workspace per project.
use_cases: arranging terminals, editors, and browsers for a project
running AI coding agents alongside code
keeping agent context within a project workspace
organizing multiple windows spatially instead of tiling
exploring new ways to code with AI agents
summary.what_it_does: CATE presents terminals, code editors, web browsers, and AI agent panels as floating panels on an infinite, zoomable canvas. Each project gets one spatial workspace where tools and agents share the same surface and keep their context. The page contrasts this with tiling layouts, which only rearrange existing windows. Listings describe it as open source and freeware, and the project is hosted on GitHub under 0-AI-UG/cate. The page text itself has few technical specifics beyond these points.
notable: Infinite zoomable canvas for terminals, editors, and browsers
One spatial workspace per project shared with AI agents
Listed under IDEs in awesome-mac lists
caveats: Platform support beyond macOS is not stated on the page
Feature details and installation requirements are not described in the page text
